scenario_description:
Objective: Complete the same-day courier release of Midway Metro’s tablet loaner kit after the handoff has already started at the dock desk.
Emerging Need: The courier scan and security release are underway, but the active ticket stops because a required recipient dock access code is blank.
Decision Context: Calendar, courier, and desk updates separate ordinary pickup progress from a live hold; the authorized code source is only in internal account/contact records.
Consequence: If the hold is not cleared while the release ticket remains live, the driver leaves and the training kit misses today’s pickup.

parameter.title: Midway Metro tablet kit courier release
parameter.description: Release sealed loaner tablet kit MM-117 at the dock desk for the supervisor lab shipment; unclaimed live courier tickets close at 15:45. The counter remains open until 15:45, but today’s route driver leaves at 15:40; MM-117 must be released before that departure.

parameter.content: Handoff started: sealed kit MM-117 is at the dock desk, the courier badge is scanned, and the driver is verifying the package label now.

parameter.subject: Pickup hold for ticket LD-8841 / kit MM-117
parameter.body: Driver check-in is paused at BrightGate dock security. The destination access-code field is blank, so kit MM-117 cannot leave the security hold. Ticket LD-8841 remains in the live release queue until 15:40; after that, this driver cannot accept the package under today's booking.

parameter.content: For tracking: the LoopDash driver is still waiting. Dock security confirms the label and seal are fine; this is a recipient-facility code hold, not a courier reprint or BrightGate desk override issue.

parameter.subject: Pickup ticket LD-8841 closed / driver departed
parameter.body: The live release queue for ticket LD-8841 has closed and the driver has departed BrightGate without kit MM-117. Packages requiring a new ticket are eligible for next-business-day pickup only.
